title: refactor: migrate msw-todo config to standard apps/manifest structure
body:
- [x] Analyze current msw-todo config vs standard format (todo, kitchen-sink, crm examples)
- [x] Refactor `examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts` to standard `apps: [App.create(...)]` + `manifest` structure
- [x] Update `examples/msw-todo/README.md` code snippets to reflect new config structure
- [x] Update ROADMAP.md to mark the related item as completed
- [x] Verify build succeeds for msw-todo example (tsc + vite build pass)
- [x] Run CodeQL security scan — no alerts found
- [x] Resolve merge conflict in ROADMAP.md (add back CRM type safety line from PR #581)

> <issue_description>examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts 并未采用 ObjectStackDefinition 标准格式，而是将 app 级属性平铺至 stack 顶层。
> 
> ### 风险
> - 配置不规范，影响示例示范和类型推断。
> - IDE/codegen 工具等无法识别结构。
> 
> ### 修复建议
> - 定义标准 manifest 字段，所有 app 级参数放入 apps: [App.create(...)]。
> - 配置拆分为 manifest/object/app，具体参见其他 example 规范写法。
